campusDescription: St. John’s Academy is a private Grades 4–12 school in British Columbia, Canada, with two campuses: Vancouver (day school) and Shawnigan Lake (IB World School with day and boarding). The school offers the BC Curriculum and IB Programme, focusing on academic excellence, English support, leadership development, and university preparation in a safe, supportive environment for local and international students.

keyQualities: St. John’s Academy is defined by strong academic excellence, a safe and supportive learning environment, and a personalized approach to education. The school focuses on small class sizes, dedicated teacher support, and clear university pathways through the BC Curriculum and IB Programme. It values global citizenship, leadership development, and holistic growth through academics, arts, sports, and community engagement.
teachingApproaches: St. John’s Academy uses a student-centered and inquiry-based approach aligned with the BC Curriculum and IB philosophy. Teaching emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and real-world application of knowledge, supported by small class sizes and individualized instruction. Teachers focus on academic excellence while also developing communication skills, creativity, and independent learning to prepare students for university success.
registrationDeadline: Rolling admissions until spots are full.

extracurricularActivities: St. John’s Academy offers a wide range of extracurricular activities, including sports teams, arts and music programs, STEM and robotics clubs, leadership opportunities, and outdoor education experiences. With over 40 clubs and activities available, students are encouraged to explore their interests, develop new skills, and build confidence beyond the classroom.

campusDescription: Pine Hills International School (PHIS) is a private school network across four campuses in Selangor's Klang Valley—Kuala Lumpur, Subang Jaya, Cheras and  Shah Alam. Pine Hills International School offering the British/Cambridge curriculum from Pre-Primary through A Levels for ages 3 to 19. Its standout feature is the Henkan Programme, a 21-day character-building initiative focused on leadership, communication, and integrity. PHIS also runs a dedicated special-needs arm, the Gifted Kids Care Centre, providing therapy and individualized education plans for children with conditions like mild autism or ADHD, with the goal of transitioning them into mainstream classes. Inclusion extends into regular campus culture too, not just the special-needs centre. The school reported strong IGCSE results (95% of students with 5+ A* grades in 2023) and offers multilingual support for international families.

keyQualities:
Mount Kelly is a values-led, life-defining School where education is about far more than academic results. Guided by the core values of Compassion, Courage, Humility, Respect, Commitment and Integrity, the School develops confident, thoughtful young people who are prepared not only for examinations, but for life.

As a close-knit day and boarding School, Mount Kelly nurtures, guides and inspires every pupil to develop their individual talents and interests. High academic expectations are complemented by exceptional pastoral care, a broad co-curricular programme and a culture that encourages resilience, ambition and service to others.

teachingApproaches:

Lessons encourage curiosity, collaboration and intellectual challenge, while regular feedback and personalised support help pupils make excellent progress. Throughout the curriculum, the emphasis is on developing not only subject knowledge but also the lifelong learning skills, adaptability and character needed to thrive in an ever-changing world.

Small class sizes enable teachers to know every pupil well, providing the challenge and guidance needed for each individual to flourish academically.

As an accredited Thinking School through the University of Exeter, Mount Kelly places critical thinking and metacognition at the heart of its teaching. Pupils are encouraged to question, make connections, solve problems and reflect on their learning, developing the confidence and independence needed for success both in School and beyond.

South Kent School is a leading all-boys boarding and day school in South Kent, Connecticut, dedicated to developing thriving young men for success in college and beyond. Rooted in more than 100 years of academic, athletic, and student traditions, South Kent combines a strong foundation in character development with a forward-thinking approach to boys’ education.

Guided by contemporary expertise in male adolescent learning, the School continuously evolves to meet the changing needs of students and the world around them. Through innovative programs, including design thinking and Future Literacy, South Kent empowers students to think critically, adapt confidently, and lead with purpose.

By providing an environment intentionally designed for boys, South Kent recognizes and supports the unique strengths, challenges, and aspirations of young men. Students are encouraged to grow academically, socially, and personally through a curriculum that values integrity, resilience, compassion, and engagement.

At South Kent, education extends beyond the classroom. The School’s mission is to prepare thoughtful, capable, and engaged citizens who are ready to thrive in an increasingly competitive and rapidly changing world while making meaningful contributions to their communities.
